product_description: AIS Market is an AI-powered competitor intelligence platform that automatically researches competitors every week and delivers branded, actionable reports. It tracks competitor website messaging, pricing changes, customer reviews, and hiring signals — then uses AI to synthesize what it all means for your business.
target_customer: Product managers and marketing teams at mid-size SaaS companies who need reliable competitive intelligence but don't have a dedicated analyst or the budget for enterprise tools like Crayon or Klue.
primary_value_prop: Get a full weekly competitor report — website changes, pricing, reviews, job postings, and AI-generated insights — delivered automatically to Google Sheets and a branded HTML report. No analysts, no manual Googling, no expensive enterprise contract.
key_differentiators: AI-powered synthesis using Claude — not just raw data, but actual strategic insight
Freemium pricing — accessible to startups and small teams, not just enterprise budgets
Zero analyst required — one person can set it up and run it weekly
Branded deliverables — reports carry your company identity, not a generic tool logo
Simple WAT architecture — transparent, auditable, and customizable without vendor lock-in
competitive_positioning: AIS Market sits below enterprise CI tools (Crayon, Klue) on price and complexity, but above manual research and generic SEO tools (SEMrush, SpyFu) on AI-driven insight quality. It targets teams who outgrew spreadsheets but can't justify a $1,000+/month enterprise platform.
